product.name: ECMS Pro
product.description: Admin web app for managing an English language center

redesignGoal: Redesign the existing admin interface while preserving its current modules, data, navigation, and workflows. Return a coherent visual system and screen concepts that can be implemented in the existing React app.
constraints: Keep all user-facing content in Vietnamese.
Do not remove or invent business capabilities; visual changes should preserve the described interactions.
Support desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.
Use clear loading, empty, success, and error states for data-driven screens.
The current app is a local development/demo UI and does not have a complete authentication flow.

layout.contentPattern: sticky top bar with scrollable page content

globalShell.responsiveBehavior: Collapse or replace the sidebar with a compact navigation pattern on narrow screens; keep all sections accessible.

screens.title: Tài khoản & Phân quyền
screens.purpose: Manage application accounts and role access.

screens.title: Giáo viên
screens.purpose: Manage teacher profiles and assigned classes.

screens.title: Học viên
screens.purpose: Manage student profiles and view their learning and payment records.

screens.title: Quản lý Khóa học
screens.purpose: Maintain courses offered by the center for enrollment and sales.
fields: category such as IELTS, TOEIC, or communication

screens.title: Quản lý Lớp học
screens.purpose: Manage concrete class schedules, teachers, rooms, enrollment capacity, and waitlists.

screens.title: Đăng ký & Xếp lớp
screens.purpose: Enroll students into classes and process class changes or preservation requests.

screens.title: Quản lý giao dịch
screens.purpose: Review student-submitted course enrollment/payment requests, record a counter transaction, and inspect invoices.
content: open course, available class, student, and transaction summary cards
actions: select student and inspect invoice history
notes: Student requests are not enrolled or invoiced until staff confirms them.
Payment integration is currently a demo and does not connect to a real payment gateway.

sharedComponents: sidebar navigation item with active state
data table with empty and loading states
redesignDeliverablesRequestedFromAI: Propose an updated visual direction and design tokens.
Redesign the admin shell and representative screens: students, classes, courses, and transactions.
Include desktop and mobile responsive behavior.
Keep Vietnamese labels and preserve the listed workflows.
Return implementation-ready component descriptions or React-compatible HTML/CSS guidance.
